notes.title: Game mechanics update, DLC, price change and contest
notes.content:
Hi there!
We have some big announcements for you regarding Nighthaw-X3000. Here is the complete list of changes:

In-game changes:

Increased overall player speed
Increased shooting speed (normal shooting speed is now equal to shooting speed in turbo mode in previous builds)
Redesigned UI (to make it easier to read)
Redesigned “Turbo” mode
Activating “Turbo” mode summons two helping droids for limited amount of time
“Turbo” gauge is now in cooldown mode – it refills itself over time. You can still speed this up by killing enemies
Nanobots were replaced with two new powerups: faster refilling of turbo gauge and prolongation of turbo mode
Changed player sprite
Additional adjustments to game difficulty
Additional adjustments to enemies HP (bosses included)
Additional, minor bug fixes and stability improvements


DLC

We are happy to announce that DLC with Official Soundtrack for the game is now available for 4,99 USD/EUR. Soundtrack contains 9 epic tracks (with one track exclusively created for our game!) created by 4 awesome bands: Do Nothing Club, VHS Dreams, TimeCop1983 and Neon Nox. Music is prepared in MP3 format, 320 kb/s.

Price change

As you can see, we’ve lowered Nighthaw-X3000 price to 4,99 USD/EUR which is now standard price for the game (this is not a timed discount).

IMPORTANT: for those who bought the game for higher, original price, we have a special present – a DLC featuring complete soundtrack from the game for free.

To grab your copy, just send us a receipt from steam which confirm that you’ve bought Nighthaw-X3000 for higher, original price. Send it to us directly via e-mail on support@aag-studio.com. We will send you back a key to activate a DLC for free.

Thank you for your understanding.

Special contest – you can win a very limited, boxed copy of the game!

Because of this changes we have a special contest for you. You can now win a special and very limited, boxed copy of the game, which was exclusive to the press up to this day. You can see the photos of the box below.

We’ve prepared 3 copies for you! For more info, go to the community hub!

Contest thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/606190/discussions/0/1333474229065219805/

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28423268/cc29016a8eaf9963578d5eb8e4aa7b1812d5d4ab.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28423268/4d5c89694adf300eeec90309aad6a4fdc45c1ba0.jpg

Thank you to all of you, who helped us during our brainstorming sessions with community to make this game better. You deserved it!
